notes: Annual prices are shown per month (line 104/109/114/119 '/mo'); annual billing saves 20% (lines 99, 246). Trial details (line 244): full access for 14 days or 100 calls, whichever comes first, plus 25 text messages; no credit card. Each additional AI agent is $9.95 per month (line 254). All prices in USD; spam never counts toward call volume (line 159); calls under 15 seconds or where caller never speaks are not billed (line 240). Number porting at no extra charge (line 242); free 30-minute onboarding call (line 248). White-glove onboarding and done-for-you integrations only on Scale and Enterprise (lines 146-149). No contract; cancel anytime (line 246). Enterprise offers volume discounts and BAAs (lines 153-155).

free_trial.text: Start using Upfirst for free for 14 days — no card required. Pick a plan when your trial is up.
